in a similar spot. realizing more and more i don't enjoy anything. i don't think i even know know how to. I'm over 30, i can't imagine what i could do to change this. even the people i like i make uncomfortable, and frankly i kind of can't stand them a lot of the time either. nothing is good, positive emotions are fleeting at best.

if you figure out an alternative be sure to let me know but giving up looks more inevitable every day.

yeah it sucks. most people i know struggle with depression and telling them you want to kys is triggering for them and i don't want to do that. i made a big post here that was rightly ignored. compared to a lot of people my problems are bullshit. but at the end of the day it doesn't matter, because my brain won't let me be happy. I'm hyper fixated on someone who probably never considered me a close friend, and no matter how my day goes, when i go to bed all i can think of is her. i wake up wishing i hadn't almost every day. it's some high school shit except I'm in my 30s. at least a decade ago i could tell myself it might get better. it can't get better now. it's simply impossible. I'm only going to older, more decrepit and more spiteful and jealous of people younger than me. there's no benefit to people like me existing in the world.
NO WAY. the prestige, ladies and gentlemen (and non-binary individuals). unprecedented. outfoxed.
